title: Patch: the account screen fills or drops its empty "This season" heading, shows the rank crest, and keeps match history's tap areas apart
thread:
**Issue #3957 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #3957: Patch: the account screen fills or drops its empty "This season" heading, shows the rank crest, and keeps match history's tap areas apart Opened by @squishy-squooby. A follow-up to the account screen (#3733, merged in #3861), found in its device-size screenshots. Part of the tracker #3726. ### What happens - **Overview, every size over 600 px:** the "This season" heading has nothing under it; "All time" follows at once. ([shot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/89d964e0dc1ba0824859c9a872cf3c54aee47285/3733-account/account-1280x720-desktop.png)) - **Header, and the Play hub's Online cards (#3729), every size:** the rank crest beside "Raisin" is nearly invisible, a dark outline on a dark ground. ([account](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/89d964e0dc1ba0824859c9a872cf3c54aee47285/3733-account/account-1280x720-desktop.png), [Play hub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/89d964e0dc1ba0824859c9a872cf3c54aee47285/3729-play-inbox/play-1280x720-desktop.png)) - **Match history, iPad sizes:** the full-width "All replays" link's tap area covers the last row's "Watch replay". - **Match history, 820 and 744:** each row's date wraps onto a second line. All 14 shots: https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/3861#issuecomment-6892235451. ### What should happen At every device size in #3726: "This season" shows this season's record when there is one, and is left out when there is none (as the ranked line already does, `account.test.tsx` around line 421). The rank crest reads clearly on the dark ground wherever it is drawn. No tap area covers another control. A history row's date stays on one line at 820 and 744, or the row lays out so a wrap reads cleanly. ### Where `apps/web/src/routes/account.tsx`, `accountSections.ts`, `account.css`; the crest is `apps/web/src/rank/RankCrest.tsx` and `rankCrest.css`, shared with `apps/web/src/routes/PlayHub.tsx`. ### Tests Cases that fail without the fix: in `apps/web/src/routes/account.test.tsx`, a player with no games this season sees no "This season" heading, and one with games sees it with their record. For the tap areas, a check in the spec that renders the account screen at `MENU_SIZES` (spec 47's `hitAreaProblems` or an overlap check). Keep the existing account tests passing. I'll take the device-size screenshots for the pull request once it merges. ## Plan _Written by `claude-7` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43699734082)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ **Goal.** On the account screen, the Overview shows a "This season" heading only when a ladder has season games, and then shows that record under it. The rank crest reads clearly on the dark ground (it is faint on the account header and the Play hub's Online cards because Raisin's and Rotten's art is dark on dark). Match history's "All replays" no longer has a tap area over the last row's "Watch replay", and a row's date never breaks across two lines. A new ruling, R3957000 (amends R3733000), records this. Tests cover each part, including spec 47's tap-area check at `MENU_SIZES`. I could not run any test here, because this worktree has no `node_modules`. The numbers below come from my own contrast calculations and from reading the code. ## Files to touch | File | | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/routes/account.tsx` | change | `Overview`: draw the heading only over a record. `MatchHistory`: date in a span, "All replays" gets `className="button-secondary"`. | | `apps/web/src/routes/account.css` | change | One rule, `.account-history__when`. | | `apps/web/src/rank/RankCrest.tsx` | change | Export `TIER_ART` and `TierArt`; recolor `raisin` and `rotten`. | | `apps/web/src/routes/account.test.tsx` | change | 3 tests for the heading. | | `apps/web/src/routes/account-sections.test.tsx` | change | 2 tests for the history row and the link. | | `apps/web/src/rank/RankCrest.test.tsx` | change | 1 contrast test. | | `e2e/cypress/component/account-screen.cy.tsx` | change | Date-on-one-line check at each size. | | `e2e/cypress/e2e/47-tap-areas.cy.ts` | change | `/account` Match history hit-area test at each size. | | `spec/rulings/R3957000.md` | new | The ruling. | | `spec/pending/3957.md` | new | Its §11 paragraph (one line, like `spec/pending/3950.md`). | Do not touch `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `crates/`, `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md` or `apps/web/src/wire/`. `accountSections.ts` and `rankCrest.css` need no change. Governing notes: `R3733000` (the account screen; amended here), `R2255000` and `R2778000` (season record left out at 0 games), `R2122000` and `R3728000` (tap areas, `MENU_SIZES`), and `R0605`, `R0607` and `R0612` (the crest). CLAUDE.md rules 3 and 7 apply. ## Steps 1. **`account.tsx`, `Overview`.** - In the local `season` helper, add `key={testid}` to its `

`. - Replace the `{rank !== null ? (<>

This season…

…) : null}` block with: ```tsx const seasonLines = [ rank === null ? null : season(rank, t("Constructed"), accountTestid.overviewSeasonRecord), randomRank === null ? null : season(randomRank, t("All random"), accountTestid.overviewRandomSeasonRecord), ].filter((line): line is ReactElement => line !== null); ``` Place this before the `return`. - In the JSX, render `{seasonLines.length > 0 ? (<>

{t("This season")}

{seasonLines}) : null}` in the same position, between `AccountIdentity` and "All time". - Leave the badges block (`rank !== null`) as it is. - Add a comment: `// R3957000: the heading only over a record, as the header's ranked line is left out at 0 games (R2255000).` 2. **`account.tsx`, `MatchHistory`.** - In the row's ``, drop the trailing `·{" "}` after the mode and write: ```tsx {row.mode === null ? null : <> · {t(MODE_WORDS[row.mode])}} ·{" "} {formatDateTime(row.endedAt, { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" })} ``` The text is unchanged, so the existing `toHaveTextContent` checks still hold. - On the "All replays" `` (testid `historyAll`), add `className="button-secondary"`. It then takes the existing `.account-section a.button-secondary { min-height: var(--hit-min) }`, so index.css draws no band. This is the same pattern as the Leaderboard link in `Overview`. - Rejected: keeping it a text link and widening the gap. The band depends on the link's line height (about 10–12px above the link against a 10px gap), so that would be fragile. 3. **`account.css`.** After `.account-history__why`, add: ```css /* R3957000: the date moves to the next line whole, never breaking inside. */ .tavern.app-shell.account-screen .account-history__when { white-space: nowrap; } ``` The date is about 170px wide and `.account-history__what` is at least 14em (224px) wide, so it fits at every `MENU_SIZES` width. 4. **`RankCrest.tsx`.** - Change `const TIER_ART` to `export const TIER_ART` and `type TierArt` to `export type TierArt`. - Raisin: `edge: "#b09a86"`, `grape: "#a08468"`, `opacity: 1`. Leave `frame: "none"` and `dash: "3 3"` alone, since the dashed outline still marks it as unplaced. - Rotten: `edge: "#a39485"`, `grape: "#a58aa0"`. Leave its frame and dash alone. - Contrast on the account panel's top stop (#341e10) and the Play card ground (#2b170c): | Tier | Outline | Berries | |---|---|---| | Raisin | 5.8–6.4:1 | 4.5–4.9:1 | | Rotten | 5.3–5.8:1 | 3.9:1 (on its frame) | - Leave every other tier alone. All tiers' outlines were already 6:1 or better except these two. - Every crest must stay a distinct drawing, and these colors differ from all others. 5. **Ruling.** - Create `spec/rulings/R3957000.md`: - `id: R3957000`. - A title along the lines of "The account's Overview names 'This season' only over a season record, the rank crest reads at 3:1 on the dark ground, Match history's All replays is a 44 px button and a row's date never breaks (issue #3957; amends R3733000)". - `cards: "§9.12, R605, R607, R612, R2122000, R2255000, R2778000, R3728000, R3733000, issue #3726, issue #3957"`. - `proven_in` lists the five test files from the Tests section below. - The body states the four rules and gives the rejected alternatives: the text link with a wider gap; a row layout with the date always on its own line; a drop shadow or backing disc behind the crest. - Create `spec/pending/3957.md` with one line: `**[[R3957000]] … (issue #3957, 2026-11-15)**: …`. Link only rulings that exist; check with `ls spec/rulings/R0605.md`. ## Tests - **`account.test.tsx`**, in the describe holding the R2255000 tests (after line 424). Use the existing `profileBody` and `rankBody` helpers and the `mockImplementation(async (_t, ladder = "constructed") => …)` pattern from line 195. In each test, await `screen.findByTestId(accountTestid.randomRank)` before asserting. - `it("R3957000 Overview has no 'This season' heading while neither ladder has a season game")`: both ladders have `record.games` 0. Assert `queryByRole("heading", { name: "This season" })` is null, both overview season testids are null, and the "All time" heading is present. - `it("R3957000 Overview's 'This season' heading sits over the record of a ladder that has season games")`: Constructed has 24 games (14–9–1), All random has 0. Assert the heading exists, `heading.nextElementSibling` is the `overviewSeasonRecord` element, which has text "Constructed: 14–9–1", and `overviewRandomSeasonRecord` is null. - `it("R3957000 … when only All random has season games")`: the heading exists and only `overviewRandomSeasonRecord` is shown, with text "All random: 3–0–0". - **`account-sections.test.tsx`**, in `describe("R3733000 match history")`. Add `readFileSync` from `node:fs` and `dirname`/`join` from `node:path`; `fileURLToPath` comes from `node:url`. Copy the CSS-reading pattern from `RankCrest.test.tsx` line 190. - `it("R3957000 a history row's date is one element the stylesheet keeps on one line")`: `openAt("history")`. Find the row `m1`, then `within(row).getByText()`. Assert it has class `account-history__when`. Read `account.css` with whitespace collapsed and assert it contains `.account-history__when { white-space: nowrap; }`. - `it("R3957000 All replays is a button-secondary link, so it is --hit-min tall and takes no band")`: assert `getByTestId(accountTestid.historyAll)` has class `button-secondary` and `href` `/replays`. - **`RankCrest.test.tsx`**: import `TIER_ART`. Add helpers `rgb(hex)`, `over(fg, bg, alpha)`, `luminance` (WCAG formula) and `contrast`, and `const MIN_CREST_CONTRAST = 3`. - `it("R3957000 every tier's outline reads at 3:1 on the dark grounds, and the berries of the two darkest tiers on what they sit on")`. - The grounds are `--pal-wood-800`, read from `../palette.css` with a regex (throw if it is missing), and `#341e10`. The latter is the lightest stop of the account panel's gradient in `auth/tavern.css` `.panel--auth`; say so in a comment. - For each ground and each tier in `Object.entries(TIER_ART)`: - Compute `outline = over(rgb(art.edge), ground, art.opacity)`. - Assert `contrast(outline, ground) >= 3`. - For `raisin` and `rotten` only, assert the berries (`over(rgb(art.grape), surface, art.opacity)`) against `surface` are also >= 3. Here `surface` is the ground when `frame` is `"none"`, otherwise the frame blended over the ground. - Do not assert berries for Normal, Large or Golden: they are 2.2–2.9:1 on their frames and are left alone (see Open questions). - **`e2e/cypress/component/account-screen.cy.tsx`**: inside the `for (const size of MENU_SIZES)` loop, add a third `it` with a template-literal title starting `R3957000 ?section=history keeps a row's date on one line at ${size.label}`. - Call `mountAt(size, "?section=history")`. - Wait for `historyRow("m1")`. - Then `cy.get(\`${byTestid(accountTestid.historyRow("m1"))} .account-history__when\`).should(...)`. Inside the callback, guard against `undefined` first, since the e2e tsconfig is strict about indexing. Assert `getClientRects().length` is 1, and that its `getBoundingClientRect().right` is at most the row's right plus 0.5. - Finish with `expectFits(size)`. - **`e2e/cypress/e2e/47-tap-areas.cy.ts`**: - Add `accountHistoryAll: "account-history-all"` to the `SCREEN` constant. - Add a fixture `HISTORY_REPLAYS`: three listings (win/bo1, loss/random, draw/null), each with `matchId`, `mode`, `endedAt` (a named constant), `seat: "p1"`, `result`, `turns`, `steps`, `portraits: { p1: "gary", p2: "timmy" }` and `opponent: { profileId: "p2", username: "Grape#12" }`, and `nextOffset: null`. The shape is `OnlineReplayListing` in `apps/web/src/net/api.ts` line 1558. - After the `/account` test in the "signed in" block, add: ```ts it("R2122000 R3957000 /account, Match history", () => { cy.intercept({ method: "GET", pathname: "/api/replays" }, { statusCode: 200, body: HISTORY_REPLAYS }); cy.visitAs(SPARE(), "/account?section=history"); cy.get(ts(SCREEN.accountHistoryAll), { timeout: timeouts.view }).should("be.visible"); expectHitAreas(size); }); ``` - Use `SPARE()` (p4), not `SIGNED_IN()`, because the history is faked and p2 is near R109's per-minute allowance. The existing touch emulation and `HIT_AREA_MEDIA` assertion already cover widths over 600 px. **Commands** (from the repo root): - `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/routes/account.test.tsx src/routes/account-sections.test.tsx src/rank/RankCrest.test.tsx` - `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck && pnpm --dir e2e typecheck:component` - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` - `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/routes apps/web/src/rank e2e` - `cargo jackioh spec check` - If the Cypress binary is installed: `cd e2e && pnpm exec cypress run --component --spec cypress/component/account-screen.cy.tsx`, then `pnpm exec cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/47-tap-areas.cy.ts` (it needs the E2E server and client from the CLAUDE.md "E2E" block). Otherwise CI's `e2e smoke` runs 47. ## Done when - [ ] "This season" shows over the record(s) that exist and is absent when no ladder has season games, with no empty heading at any size. - [ ] Raisin's and Rotten's crests read at 3:1 or better on both dark grounds, in the account header and on the Play hub's Online cards (one component, `RankCrest`). - [ ] "All replays" is a 44px `button-secondary` link, and spec 47's new `/account` Match history test measures it at every `MENU_SIZES` entry. - [ ] A history row's date is a nowrap span, and the component spec checks it is one line at every size. - [ ] The ruling note, the pending paragraph and a test named `R3957000` in each `proven_in` file all exist. - [ ] The existing account, account-sections and RankCrest tests still pass, including the "17 distinct crests" test. - [ ] These checks pass: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh patches check`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, the web tests, typecheck and eslint, and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`. - [ ] No `eslint-disable`, `@ts-ignore`, `.skip` or `.only` was added. ## Risks - **Spec 47 unverified.** I could not confirm the new 47 test fails without the fix. The old overlap depends on the link's line height and on rows being one line (about 10.8px band against a 10px gap). If the builder can run Cypress, revert step 2's class and check that the test fails; if not, CI checks it. - **Crest tests.** `RankCrest.test.tsx` counts 17 distinct drawings, so keep the new colors different from every other tier's. The match board's rank rail (`match.tsx`, `board.css`) draws the same crest; no test pins crest colors, but eyeball it if the UI skill is used. - **Selectors.** The `TIER_ART` export is test-only. Keep `account-history__when` out of `data-testid`: `account-sections.test.tsx` line 289 matches `/^account-history-g/`. - **Keys.** `seasonLines` is an array of elements, so each needs its key (step 1) or React warns. - **Purity.** No crate or `wire/` file changes, so there is no determinism, replay or hidden-information risk, and `git status -- apps/web/src/wire` stays clean. The change is presentation only (rule 7). ## Open questions - Normal, Large and Golden berries are 2.2–2.9:1 on their frames, under 3:1. I left them, since the issue names the crest "beside Raisin" and their outlines are bright. A person can ask for them to be lifted too. - I chose a full-width secondary button over a text link for "All replays", matching Overview's Leaderboard link. Say so if a link look is wanted. - I kept the difficulty at medium: web, spec and e2e only, no engine, AI, migration or cross-crate design, about 10 files. ````
